dataset.applicability_limitation: This dataset represents food-delivery operations; results may not generalize to quick-commerce. Actual quick-commerce operational data is required for stronger validation.

sla.statement: Since the official SLA was not specified in the available hackathon requirements, a 30-minute analytical SLA was selected based on the delivery-time distribution. It is used for analytical modelling and operational insights, not as an officially guaranteed delivery promise.

availability_assumptions.Order_Date: Assumes the order calendar date is recorded at submission.
availability_assumptions.Time_Orderd: Assumes this is the order-submission time, not a later derived timestamp.
availability_assumptions.Type_of_order: Assumes the customer-selected order category is known at submission.
availability_assumptions.City: Assumes the destination city/service area is known from the order address at submission.
availability_assumptions.Festival: Assumes the date/location calendar flag is derivable before the order-placement prediction.
availability_assumptions.distance_km: Assumes the selected restaurant/dark store and customer destination coordinates are known before prediction; verify store-selection timing in the operational workflow.

rider_experience.limitation: Rider tenure/years of experience is not present; age is not a substitute.
rider_experience.age_rule_note: Module 02 age summaries use the 18-80 validation range.

multiple_deliveries.interpretation: Neutral encoded-value labels; no data dictionary was available.

eda.rider_limitation: Rider tenure/experience is unavailable; age is not a substitute.
